item.title: Reflections
item.description:
Reflections Stephen Wingate

Source: TW

Author: Stephen Wingate

Visit Stephen’s website - Self Knowledge, for audio talks, blog etc.

See Stephen’s entry on the Teacher pages.

What do you want ultimately?

What is real?

What is imagination?

Imagination can be seen. Can what is real be seen?

Is imagination troubling you? Do you take images to be real and run from them or long after them?

Awareness is the ultimate context of all existence. Not an idea of awareness, but awareness itself, yourself.

item.title: Who Sets the Intention to be Free of Seeking?
item.description:
Who Sets the Intention to be Free of Seeking? Stephen Wingate

Source: TW

Author: Stephen Wingate

The following is an extract from the above book, The Outrageous Myths of Enlightenment , which is available from Atma Publishing.

Visit Stephen’s website - Self Knowledge, for audio talks, blog etc.

See Stephen’s entry on the Teacher pages.

Q: I find your writings very helpful, especially the essay entitled Reflections in which you say, ‘Home is awareness. Home is peace. Home is heaven. All paths to heaven lead to hell’. It was helpful when you made the suggestion to stop and look. Can you give me some pointers to look within to see who feels disturbed? Should I look at what doesn’t stop, when you say, ‘stop’? When I ask myself, ‘What is real?’ my body/mind quiets down, and feels less agitated. Should I try to look at what is real? Does that cover it?
